facts.text: Under the Luther Scholar Guarantee, Concordia awards up to full tuition funding to new freshmen in the pre-seminary track planning to become LCMS pastors.

sources.title: Luther Scholar Guarantee - Concordia University Wisconsin
sources.quote: Undergraduates who are new freshman, who are planning to be LCMS pastors, and who declare a pre-seminary track are eligible to receive additional funding up to full tuition. Concordia awards two full tuition Luther Scholars recipients each year.
